page_limit = 20
found = None

    resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at', dont_reorder_pinned=True)
    notes_meta = resp if isinstance(resp, list) else resp.get('notes', [])
    if not notes_meta:
        break
    meta_notes.extend(notes_meta)
    for n in notes_meta:
        if n.get('title') == f'Habit Tracking Log for {yesterday_iso}':
            found = n
            break
    if found is not None or len(notes_meta) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

        new_lines.append(line)

# Also show first 3 and last 3 lines for sanity

for l in new_lines[:5]:

print('...')

    print(l)

# Check if today note already exists
existing = []
